## Audit Complete

**Finding Summary:**

```
new/dart-gen-bs/gen_app_peruk12_ent1.dart:48 · Infinity.toStringAsFixed(2) crash when קילומטראז׳ is empty · P0 compile-break · Guard denominator: if denom==0 return '0.00' else (numerator/denom).toStringAsFixed(2)

new/dart-gen-bs/gen_app_peruk12_ent1.dart:174 · Same divide-by-zero crash in form live display · P0 compile-break · Same guard: check denom!=0 before _calc; pass 0.0 if zero

```

**Root cause:** The computed formula `(num.tryParse(_v[3] ?? '') ?? 0) / (num.tryParse(_v[4] ?? '') ?? 0)` does not guard against division by zero. When the denominator field is empty/null, it becomes `0`, and dividing any non-zero number by zero yields `Infinity`. Calling `.toStringAsFixed(2)` on Infinity throws a RangeError at runtime in both form display (line 174) and save (line 48).

The task is **not done**—the formula will crash the app whenever a user enters a price without a kilometer reading.

Full audit written to `./_audit-compile.md`.
